_review: W_NEXT_NOT_LOADED: horde_tirisfal_05-10 is the next band to be written.

dropped.reason: Requires level 6, and the Darkhound mobs run lvl 5-10 (Ravenous Darkhound 9-10). Handed to 05-10.
Scarlet Zealots are lvl 8-11 and the preQuestSingle 427 is outside this band. Handed to 05-10.
Priest chain (needs 5651 first): starts at Duesten in Deathknell at level 5 and ends near Brill. Handed to 05-10.
Priest breadcrumb from Duesten in Deathknell: needs level 5, and this band ends in Brill. Handed to 05-10.
Deathknell gift voucher: pets only, no XP, and the voucher never reaches the player.
Undercity pet quest (Excitable Slime): no XP, and it lies in Undercity, off this band's path.
Punish 5 Deathguards for Zygand: no objective or XP data in the DB, so it cannot be routed.
Reports from Dillinger, Kristof and Gordo: no XP data, and the Kristof source is listed at level 55.
Escort out of Crusader's Outpost (quest lvl 7, rl 5): long walk and escort risk. Handed to 05-10.
